sections.title: 性格
sections.text: 日主辛金坐酉，月时两戌藏辛，比肩通根，性有主见而内敛。月干壬水伤官透出，年时戊印亦透，印重卫金，心思细密而重规矩，外柔内执，遇事先自持。辰戌两冲，年与月、时相激，内心时有反复，酉戌相害，人际易生暗隙，须防自责与多虑。

sections.title: 事业
sections.text: 月令印星当权，戊印两透，格局偏向文书、专业、制度、教育、辅佐之途。伤官壬水透月，能吐秀，宜以才学技艺立身。辰酉合、申酉戌会金，比劫成群，独立作业尚可，合作易生争功。行运遇木火财官，格局转清，事业方见舒展。

sections.title: 财运
sections.text: 原局财星藏于年支辰中乙木、支中不见明财，财源须靠泄秀转化。比肩叠见，钱财易分夺，不宜合伙保财。走木火运，财官透出，方能聚财；行土金运，印比加重，反主耗散。理财以稳健自守为宜。

sections.title: 感情
sections.text: 日支酉为比肩，配偶宫坐同气，伴侣性格有主见，相处易如兄弟而少柔。酉戌相害在月日、日时之间，感情易生隔膜与误会，辰戌冲亦动家庭根气。宜择性情温厚者，多沟通忍让，方能久长。

sections.title: 健康
sections.text: 金旺印重，土金之气偏胜，辰戌冲、酉戌害，须留意肺金、呼吸道及脾胃运化。木火受制，肝气与心血亦宜调养。作息规律、情志舒畅为宜，如有不适请及时就医。

advice: 以专业文书技艺立身，少与人争利。
行木火运时积极进取，土金运时守成。
情绪多自察，伴侣间多沟通化解隔膜。

sections.title: 性格
sections.text: 日主辛酉，坐下比肩，月透壬水伤官，年时两戊正印夹身。金白水清，心思明敏而语带锋芒；印重土厚，又见固执保守。伤官吐秀则喜表现、不服管束，正印双透则重名誉、念旧恩。辛金本性刚锐，酉金助之比肩心强，事多亲力亲为，不轻易示弱，也不轻易低头。日支无杂，性情专一，认定之事九牛难挽；月支戌中丁火七杀暗藏，遇压迫反激其志，能忍亦能发。整体外柔内刚，才思胜于口才，自尊胜于财利。

sections.title: 事业
sections.text: 调候取壬洩旺金、甲疏厚土。本局壬透月干，甲木仅藏于年支辰中余气，疏土之力不足，故一生须借木火之年运开启局面。印重身强，宜从文教、文书、审核、技术、金融、法律、行政等需精细与规矩之业；伤官透干，亦利凭借口才、创意、设计、传播谋生。若一味守成，则土厚金埋，事倍功半；逢水木运展其才，可掌实权或自立门户。

sections.title: 财运
sections.text: 年支辰中藏乙木偏财，为全局唯一明根之财，又受戊土盖头，财源来得晚而须力取。月干壬水伤官能生乙木，是生财之源，故财多由技艺、作品、口才、服务而来，非坐等可获。土重则财被印夺，忌以本求利、囤积不动产过重；逢甲乙木透出之运，财路方显，但须防比劫分夺。

sections.title: 感情
sections.text: 日坐酉金比肩，夫妻宫为同气之金，配偶多刚强好胜，或与命主性情相近，易生争持。妻星乙木藏于年支辰中，位置远而受土压，正缘多在离乡之后、或经年长之人引荐方得。月支戌、时支戌各藏丁火七杀，官杀不透，感情不喜张扬，多务实少浪漫。比肩重则易有第三者或旧情牵扰，宜以印之涵养化之，多沟通、少争胜，婚姻可稳。

sections.title: 健康
sections.text: 金旺土厚，水被土制，木受土压。金主肺与呼吸，土主脾胃，金寒土燥则易见咳喘、鼻敏感、皮肤干燥、消化不畅之象；水弱则肾与泌尿、津液不足，宜多饮水、少食辛辣燥热。月支戌、时支戌火土并藏，心火易亢，睡眠须调。命理仅供参照，身体不适请及时就医，不可据以自行诊断用药。

advice: 以水木为喜，多亲近流水、林木之地，方位宜东南、东方。
忌土金过重，不宜久居燥土之地，居家宜通风保湿。
行事借伤官吐秀，以技艺、文才立身，切忌固守旧局。

sections.title: 性格
sections.text: 日主辛金坐酉禄，月支时支皆藏辛比肩，日主同五行通根月、日、时三柱，比肩成势，故性情刚介自立、主意坚定，不肯随人俯仰。年柱戊辰、时柱戊戌两透正印，印重则心慈念旧、重规矩体面，然印多则思虑繁、行动缓，易以稳妥自缚。月透壬水伤官，聪慧外露、口才敏锐，喜以己意评判是非；伤官与正印并见，既守礼法又暗存反骨。辰戌冲两见，年时与月支相战，内心常有翻腾不安，遇事易反复思量。酉戌害叠见月日、日时，亲近之人反多磨擦，情面上不肯低头。藏干乙木偏财、丁火七杀皆未透，进取之心存于内而少显于外。时柱已知，晚景心性可参；然命宫身宫未提供，此层不论。

sections.title: 事业
sections.text: 身强印旺，宜以财官为用力处。原局伤官透月，聪明才干在言辩、技艺、谋略一路；正印两透，宜文教、行政、体制内或需资历凭信之门。辰酉合、辰戌冲并见，早年根基不稳，多迁动转换，遇土金之运助身太过，反主劳而少功。须待财官透发之年运，方见施展。总体上以专业本领取胜，忌恃强独断、与人争锋。丁火七杀藏于月时两戌，权柄不显，须运助方得；丙火正官惟大运透出，非原局所有，故不宜自许高位。

sections.title: 财运
sections.text: 全局木仅中气一位，财星极弱，唯年支藏乙偏财，财不透干，主财来不显、聚散由人，非坐享丰盈之命。金土过重，比肩争财，故合伙分利、亲友借贷最易破耗，宜自立门户、亲掌财权。见财之运（乙卯、甲寅）方能起色，然原局酉戌害、辰戌冲并见，得财之时多有纷争牵累。己未偏印当前，偏印生身而夺食，进财之路偏于劳心，宜守成不宜扩张。

sections.title: 感情
sections.text: 比肩成势，日支坐酉为比肩本气，夫妻宫为同类占据，主性情相类、亦主争强不让，配偶或有主张，相处易生角力。酉戌害见于日时与月日，亲近之间多龃龉，话不投机则生嫌隙。财星为妻，原局木弱不透，妻缘来得较迟，或聚少离多。辰戌冲、辰酉合交互，聚散之象明显，宜以宽和化刚，不宜以理压人。丁火七杀藏戌，亦主感情中暗藏执着。

sections.title: 健康
sections.text: 金土最旺，火水俱弱，木仅中气，五行偏枯之象。金旺则肺与皮毛、大肠之气偏刚，土重则脾胃易滞，水火不足则心肾之气不充。辰戌冲两见，冲主动荡，戌未刑破叠见，尤须留意脾胃与腰足。宜多疏木泄土，慎思虑、节饮食，勿以刚强自恃。若有不适，应及时就医，命理不作医疗断语。

advice: 用神在木火水，宜向东方、南方求发展，多近文教、技艺、生发之业，忌一味守成。
比肩重重，钱财宜自掌管，慎合伙与担保，免争财耗散。
性刚喜胜，宜以宽和养情，酉戌害之象自可缓减。

texts: A life of ups and downs with good fortune in later years; outwardly gentle but inwardly firm, strong-willed yet given to much thought.

All three schools agree: the self is strong and the resource star is prosperous; Wood, Fire, and Water are favorable, while Earth and Metal are unfavorable. One should build a foundation through professional skill and learning. With Friend stars heavy, partnerships and disputes over money are inadvisable; in later luck, Wood becomes prosperous and things improve.

Shen and Ren emphasize the exposure of the wealth, officer, and Hurting Officer stars and the harm of Earth and Metal; Yu Chuntai emphasizes Water and Wood for Tiao Hou (climate balance of the chart), stressing that wealth comes from releasing the showy energy and that Wood luck is needed to open up the situation.

In the birth chart, the day master is Xin (Metal), sitting on You, with two Xu in the month and hour pillars concealing Xin, so the Friend (Bi Jian) is rooted across three pillars. The resource star, Wu (Earth), appears twice, making this a chart with a strong self and heavy resource. When the self is strong, wealth, authority, and output stars are needed to drain or control it, so all three schools agree to take Wood, Fire, and Water as favorable elements, and avoid Earth and Metal, which would further strengthen the self.

The month stem Ren Water, the Hurting Officer, is exposed, giving clear Metal and pure Water, with intelligence showing outwardly. One should establish oneself in refined fields such as education, writing, technical work, or creative work. But heavy resource can rob the output, making one prone to overthinking and slow action, strong at holding steady but somewhat lacking in breaking new ground.

In the original chart, the wealth star is only hidden in Yi Wood within the year branch Chen and is not exposed, and it is covered by Wu Earth, so Direct Wealth comes late and must be earned by effort. With Friend stars in a group, money is easily divided and seized, and partnerships or guarantees most easily drain it. One should keep control of finances personally and do things oneself.

With two clashes between Chen and Xu and an added harm between You and Xu, the year pillar and the month and hour pillars stir against each other. The heart often turns over, and close people instead bring more friction. In relationships, the spouse palace holds the Friend star, so the partner has a similar temperament and quarrels arise easily. Only tolerance and communication can make it last.
Use tolerance to soften sharpness, build a foundation with expertise, manage money personally, and step back where competition would arise.
Focus on deeply developing one professional skill or writing craft, and establish yourself through ability.
The Hurting Officer Ren Water is exposed in the month and can release showy talent; with heavy resource, it is better to win through talent and skill.
During Wood and Fire luck periods, such as Ding Si, Bing Chen, Yi Mao, and Jia Yin, advance actively.
Manage money yourself, and avoid partnerships, loans, and guarantees.
Friend stars appear repeatedly and the wealth star is not exposed, so partnerships most easily divide and drain resources.

Avoid only defending what is established and clinging to old patterns, lest thick Earth bury Metal and much effort yield little result.

The month branch Xu hides Wu (Earth) resource, which appears in the heavenly stems. The Xin day master has rooted support in You and Xu, so resource and peers form a strong force. Wood and Fire, Wealth and Officer, should be taken to release and control it.

The Day Master is Xin Metal seated on You, while the two Xu in the month and hour pillars hide Xin. The Friend stems share the same root, giving a nature that has its own views yet is reserved. The Ren Water Hurting Officer on the month stem is exposed, and the Wu seal in the year and hour is also exposed. The seal is heavy and guards the Metal, so the mind is meticulous and values rules; outwardly gentle but inwardly firm, one first steadies oneself when facing matters.
